name: community-quote
description: Turn messages and text into "Make it a Quote" images

configFields.label: Quote Channel
configFields.description: Channel where generated quotes are posted. Leave empty to post quotes in the channel where the command is used.

configFields.label: Theme
configFields.description: Dark desaturates the avatar. Color keeps the avatar in full color.

configFields.label: Watermark
configFields.description: Text shown in the corner of the quote image. Leave empty to hide it.

configFields.label: Name Source
configFields.description: Use the server nickname or the account's global name.

configFields.label: Avatar Source
configFields.description: Use the per-server avatar or the account's global avatar.

configFields.label: Strip Markdown
configFields.description: Remove Discord markdown from quoted text instead of quoting it exactly as written.

configFields.label: Resolve Mentions
configFields.description: Turn user, role, channel, and timestamp tokens into readable text.
